column1: # The dungeon command vocabulary, which the suite has never seen.
# `Must open first!` and the dungeon's own refusals have never appeared in a
# sampled stock frame. `dungeon-search` and `dungeon-chest-refusals` work the
# same save but stop on different lines.
# Walks the dungeon's own verbs in turn from the search save: open with
# nothing there, get with nothing there, then klimb.
# Measured 2026-09-13: it covers ` 0pen-What`, ` Get` / `Not here!` and
# ` Klimb-Up!`, and its `klimb` beat reproduces the row difference that
# holds three blank rows under `Exit to Britannia!` and this engine holds
# two. This is the smaller repro: five keys from the seed rather than a
# torch, a klimb and a look.
# requires-seed: the dungeon-search save, on a dungeon level
